subscription_enabled.description: Master switch for subscription acquisition UI and paywall entry points.

subscription_plans_json.description: Optional JSON array of subscription plans. Google Play Billing prices override these display prices when available.

privacy_policy_url.description: Browser URL opened from Privacy Policy links in Settings, Profile, and Privacy & Security.

terms_and_conditions_url.description: Browser URL opened from Terms & Conditions links in Settings and Profile.

app_share_url.description: App URL included when users share LumoraAI from Settings or Profile.

interval_inter_all.description: Seconds between inter_all impressions, independently tracked (0-600).

enable_inter_back.description: Enable feature exit interstitials when no task was started.

interval_inter_back.description: Seconds between inter_back impressions, independently tracked (0-600).

interval_inter_generate.description: Seconds between inter_generate impressions, independently tracked (0-600).

inter_back_adunit.description: AdMob interstitial unit for feature exits.

inter_all_adunit.description: AdMob interstitial unit for Home feature taps; legacy Inter_all_adunit remains supported.

inter_generate_adunit.description: AdMob interstitial unit for task starts.
